svg.title: Natural Telegram conversation and one shared outreach workflow
svg.desc: Telegram messages enter a saved queue. A LangGraph conversation loop remembers recent exchanges, reads files or public websites, searches when configured, and answers. Outreach requests become a concrete proposal; after the owner starts it, the existing outreach graph researches, qualifies, checks contacts, writes, reviews, and pauses for exact-message approval. The dashboard and optional guided setup use the same outreach service. SQLite holds jobs, history, evidence, usage, checkpoints and approvals.
